variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, semi-dwarf, medium slender variety suitable for cultivation across country under irrigated lowland growing conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2018 for planting in Boro season having higher yield than commonly grown variety BRRI dhan28. Good tolerance to leaf blast and leaf blight. Non-shattering and non-lodging variety.
